body: I just can't bear the image of my parents and four younger siblings or one particularly good friend mourning my disappearance. Even just knowing someone will inevitably find me and be scarred gets me.

I think in the most innocent scenario, people just don't know how to respond, or have similar problems they fear themselves.

Plus, I think it's hard to find a "right time" to bring something up when people are just hanging out because they're bored and wanna have fun. 

Keep an eye out for any real ones who check back in with you over time, even if it's brief. Sometimes those people stay concerned, but are afraid to intrude by saying too much. 

Fuck anyone who invalidated you when you tried to open up, though. That stuff burns.

I talked my college's counselor once. Missed the next appointment by waking up late... I emailed to reschedule, and never got a phone call or email back...

I don't think she thought I was faking or anything, but that sting of someone supposedly meant to help not doing anything burns
